title: Text: DET Rick Anderson ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Sorry Anthony just got your message, been traveling home. I do watch the playoffs whenever I can. Going to be interesting to see how the league series come out. Hope you’re doing well, stay warm
Nice, did you take the long way or something?
How well do you know Rick Knapp? ATL guy asked me about him. He pre-dates my time on the beat. Not sure if he’s under consideration for their job, so keep it on the DL, but I told him I’d ask around
We stopped at Branson for a week and saw some shows. Knapp is a good pitching coordinator but has trouble as a pitching coach.  Very knowledgable, just is best suited as a coordinations
